## Summary

## Compatibility

- [ ] The change is additive within the existing versioned package, or a new
      package version contains the incompatible contract.
- [ ] Removed fields or enum values reserve their old names and numbers.
- [ ] Existing gRPC and HTTP behavior remains compatible.

## Verification

- [ ] `make verify` or `make verify-docker`
- [ ] Generated Go and OpenAPI changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, rollout, and SDK effects are documented.
